title: Custom themes for Claude Code Desktop
summary: Describe a look and Claude Code Desktop builds it: your colours and an animated backdrop, like a synthwave sunset behind the chat. It is a mod, and it works in local sessions.

assets.excerpt: A frame at 0:24 of the post video

prompts.text: Make me a Claude Code Desktop theme with a synthwave sunset and neon pink accents, as a mod that follows https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/mods/overview. Write it in a new folder, and ask me before you install or load anything.
prompts.label: Synthwave sunset and neon pink

action.label: Make a Claude Code theme in Atu

requirements: Claude Code Desktop, updated to the latest version
